menu_options.pick_ezviz: Start from a camera of the EZVIZ integration

confirm.title: Confirm camera {serial}
confirm.description: Name and local IP address come from the EZVIZ integration. Enter the verification code of the camera: the 6-letter code on its label, or the one you set in the EZVIZ app.

manual.title: Camera details
manual.description: The password is the 6-letter verification code on the camera label (or the one you set in the EZVIZ app).

reconfigure.title: Change camera details
reconfigure.description: Leave the verification code empty to keep the current one.

reauth_confirm.title: EZVIZ account login refused
reauth_confirm.description: EZVIZ no longer accepts the login of {account}, so detection events are paused. Enter the current password of the EZVIZ account.

reauth_code.title: EZVIZ verification code
reauth_code.description: EZVIZ sent a verification code to the phone or e-mail of the account. Enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: The camera did not answer with these details.
error.cloud_unreachable: The EZVIZ cloud did not answer. Try again later.

abort.reauth_successful: EZVIZ account updated. Detection events start again.

init.title: Options
init.description: Detection events and their snapshots are read from the EZVIZ cloud with your EZVIZ account (the same one you use in the EZVIZ app). Leave the account empty to use only the SD card. The alarm entity colours the armed periods on the timeline.

data.serial: Camera serial (to read its detection events)
data.people_only: The camera detects people only (every detection counts as a person)
data.cloud_password: EZVIZ account password (leave empty to keep the saved one)

cloud_code.title: EZVIZ verification code
cloud_code.description: EZVIZ sent a verification code to the phone or e-mail of the account. Enter it here; it is asked only once.

error.cloud_unreachable: The EZVIZ cloud did not answer. Check the region and try again.
error.password_required: Enter the password of the EZVIZ account.

save_clip.name: Save clip
save_clip.description: Saves a piece of the SD-card recording to a file. It waits until the end of the clip has been recorded, then copies it at real-time speed.

entry_id.name: Camera entry
entry_id.description: The camera (config entry). Give this or the camera name.

camera.name: Camera name
camera.description: The camera name, as an alternative to the config entry.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the clip, in local time (the camera clock), e.g. the time of a detection minus 10 seconds.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the clip in seconds.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Path of the MP4 file to write; the folder must be allowed in allowlist_external_dirs (/media is).

save_event_image.name: Save event image
save_event_image.description: Saves the snapshot of a detection to a file.

entry_id.name: Camera entry
entry_id.description: The camera (config entry). Give this or the camera name.

camera.name: Camera name
camera.description: The camera name, as an alternative to the config entry.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: The event_id of the ezviz_recordings_detection event.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Path of the JPEG file to write; the folder must be allowed in allowlist_external_dirs (/media is).
